from.place: Proof paragraph 1: the qcqs subsite has a site structure, finite limits and inclusion preserving fibre products and coverings.

title: Qcqs pro-etale subsite and finite limits
statement: For a scheme X [def-pc-scheme] with its pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and qcqs conventions [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], the full subcategory of X_proetale on quasi-compact and quasi-separated objects, equipped with finite pro-etale covering families, is a site. It has fibre products and finite limits computed as scheme limits; its inclusion into X_proetale preserves fibre products and sends coverings to coverings. In every slice over an object T of this subsite, finite limits agree with scheme limits over T. Adjoining finitely many arrows with a common target to a finite covering family preserves the covering property.
